pages.title: A Green Plan for Europe
pages.content:
The European Commission is part of the European Union (EU). On 11 December 2019, it shared a new plan. The name of the plan is the Green Deal. The Green Deal wants to protect our world. It wants a clean economy. By 2050, the EU wants its net greenhouse gas emissions to be zero. The plan wants to make work, factories, and everyday life more eco-friendly. This can help the climate and keep the world healthy.

One big goal is to use less and throw away less. The Green Deal helps a circular economy. In a circular economy, people repair, reuse, and recycle things. They do not throw them away. This protects nature. The Green Deal has many useful ideas for this big change.

vocabulary.definition: Keep something safe.
The money, work, and business of a country.
A gas that keeps heat in the air and makes the Earth warmer.
Gases that cars and factories send into the air.
Good for nature, or not bad for it.
An economy in which people repair, reuse, and recycle things.

pages.title: The Most Important Goals
pages.content:
Here are the most important goals of the Green Deal:

Fighting Climate Change: Climate change is a very important global problem. By 2030, European countries want to make greenhouse gas emissions at least 55% lower. By 2050, they want climate neutrality. This can slow down global warming and the problems that it brings.

Protecting Nature: The Green Deal wants people to protect nature, water, and forests. People must not cut down too many trees. We must not use too much water. Plants and animals must stay safe. The Green Deal also wants to repair nature. The goal is clean air, clean water, healthy fields, and healthy food for everyone.

A New Economy: The Green Deal helps green technology and eco-friendly businesses. In this way, the economy can grow, and nature can stay safe.

vocabulary.definition: Try hard to stop something bad.

pages.title: Why Is the Green Deal Important?
pages.content:
Climate change and pollution are a big danger for our world. Factories and machines in the old system use too much oil, coal, and gas. These are fossil fuels. We cannot use them in this old way for a long time because they damage nature. Many people think that a net-zero economy is the best way to fight climate change. It can also protect plants and animals and help us have safe energy in the future.

Today, safe energy is a big problem. Because of wars and problems between countries, nobody knows what will happen next. Energy prices are high, and some goods cannot arrive on time. This is hard for many companies, especially for factories that use a lot of energy. Electricity, oil, and gas become expensive.

pages.title: Energy from the Wind and the Sun
pages.content:
So, more and more countries are using renewable energy, like energy from the wind and the sun. It is often cheaper. With it, countries do not need expensive fossil fuels. To keep their factories strong, countries need new rules, more renewable energy, and workers with new skills.

So, the green change must be faster. Then factories can get clean energy at a good price. Countries and companies should make a big plan. The plan shows the cost of new clean technology and new factories.

pages.title: New Opportunities
pages.content:
In the next 20 or 30 years, a new green future starts. At that time, the gases that we put into the air will be the same as the gases that we take out. With the new net-zero era, the economy will create new markets, new clean technology, and new ways to make energy. Some countries spend money on clean technology early and move fast. These countries can have a strong place in this new economy. They can also be the leaders in the world at clean technology and at fighting climate change.

The green economy brings new kinds of factories and jobs. These jobs need workers with new skills. Factories also become modern and eco-friendly. To help, the EU made a law. Its name is the Net-Zero Industry Act. It helps Europe build batteries, wind turbines, heat pumps, and solar panels. It also helps Europe build machines that catch carbon dioxide and keep it in a safe place.

pages.title: New Rules for Green Things
pages.content: New rules for eco-friendly products are important too. They help people build, reuse, and recycle green technology. For example, big companies in the EU cannot throw away clothes that nobody bought. Other rules make spare parts easy to find, so people can repair their things. In the future, these rules will be for many more everyday things. Factories will have to follow these rules and protect nature.

pages.title: Smart Shopping and Green Jobs
pages.content:
In fact, the Green Deal needs people to buy smart, eco-friendly items. For this, people need clear information. Before they buy something, they should see how eco-friendly it is. Then they can choose green things. For example, fridges and washing machines have energy labels. With these labels, people can easily see which one is better. More information helps the green change.

The green change is also changing jobs. In the last few years, the number of green jobs has grown fast. Workers need new skills, so countries need big training programs. Clean energy companies and eco-friendly factories need more workers. In the future, companies will try hard to find workers with the right skills.

pages.title: Learning and Working Together
pages.content:
Finally, the green change needs good education. Countries must train workers and teach people well. This is important for green factories, for a fair change for everyone, and for net-zero goals. So, education is a big part of the Green Deal. It helps everyone learn green and digital skills. Education and training are important for the future of our world.

Countries, companies, and people should all help with these plans. Then these ideas can become real actions for a cleaner world. Climate change is a problem for every country in the world. So, it is good for countries to work together with their partners. Türkiye also made its own Green Deal Action Plan in 2021. Its goal is net-zero emissions by 2053.

pages.title: Language Review
pages.content: Review and use the language of the whole book.

exercises.title: Look: Must or Must Not?
exercises.instructions: Sort the sentences into two groups.
exercises.question: Is it something we need to do, or something we must stop?

dragDropGroups.group: Must: we need to do it
items: Plants and animals must stay safe.
Countries must train workers and teach people well.
So, the green change must be faster.
People must not cut down too many trees.
We must not use too much water.

Must: we need to do it: Plants and animals must stay safe.
Countries must train workers and teach people well.
So, the green change must be faster.
Must not: stop it: People must not cut down too many trees.
We must not use too much water.

exercises.explanation: “Must” says something is necessary. “Must not” says something is not OK.

exercises.title: Look: Compare
exercises.instructions: Choose the sentence with a correct comparative.
exercises.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: Renewable energy is often cheaper than fossil fuels.
Renewable energy is often more cheap than fossil fuels.
Renewable energy is often cheaper that fossil fuels.
exercises.explanation: Short adjectives take -er + than: cheaper than.

exercises.title: Look: Will
exercises.instructions: Is the sentence true or false?
exercises.question: In “The economy will create new markets”, the action is in the future.
exercises.explanation: “Will + base verb” talks about the future.

feedback.correct: Correct. It is in the future.

exercises.title: Practise: Linking Words
exercises.instructions: Fill each gap from the word bank. Two words are not needed.
exercises.question: Which word fits?
exercises.fillBlanksText: We cannot use fossil fuels in this old way [blank] they damage nature. [blank] wars, energy prices are high. Workers need new skills, [blank] countries need big training programs.
exercises.explanation: “Because” + a sentence and “because of” + a noun give the reason. “So” gives the result.

feedback.correct: Well done. Because, Because of, so.
feedback.incorrect: Is it a reason or a result?

exercises.title: Practise: Choose the Form
exercises.instructions: Choose the correct form for each sentence.
exercises.question: Which form fits?

formChoices.sentence: Before they buy something, they [choice] see how eco-friendly it is.
Big companies in the EU [choice] throw away clothes that nobody bought.
The Green Deal wants [choice] our world.

exercises.explanation: After should and cannot, use the base verb. After want, use to + verb.

feedback.incorrect: Check the verb after each word.

exercises.title: Practise: Correct the Sentences
exercises.instructions: Find the mistake and choose the correct form.
exercises.question: Which form is correct?

errorItems.sentence: Old machines use too many oil.
Plants and animals must to stay safe.
The economy will creates new jobs.

exercises.explanation: Use “too much” with oil. After must and will, use the base verb.

feedback.correct: Correct. Too much, must stay, will create.
feedback.incorrect: Check the words after must and will.

exercises.title: Use: A New Context
exercises.instructions: Read about a school garden. Fill each gap from the word bank.
exercises.question: Can you use the book’s words in a new text?
exercises.fillBlanksText: Our school has a new garden. We want to [blank] the birds and the trees. There is no [blank] in our garden. We are learning a new [blank]: growing vegetables. Our school [blank] is not only in the classroom.
exercises.explanation: Protect, pollution, skill and education come from the book. Here they describe a school garden.

feedback.correct: Well done. You used the book’s words in a new text.
feedback.incorrect: Read the words around each gap.

exercises.title: Use: Check a Short Text
exercises.instructions: A student wrote about saving energy. Find each mistake.
exercises.question: What should the student change?

errorItems.sentence: We should turning off the lights.
A bike is more cheap than a car.
Because of we save energy, our bills are low.

exercises.explanation: Use the base verb after should, -er for short adjectives, and “because” before a sentence.

feedback.incorrect: Check the verb, the adjective and the linker.

exercises.title: Use: My Green Step
exercises.instructions: Write four to five sentences about your green step.
exercises.question: What will you do, and why?
exercises.explanation: Example: “My green step is to use less plastic. Every day, I will take my own bottle to school. I will also repair my old bag. This is important because plastic is bad for nature. A small step can help our world.”

feedback.correct: Check: your step, will and because.

discussionPrompts.question: Say how you will do it, with will.
